# Patterns that must never appear on the public main branch.
# One extended-regex pattern per line, matched against each added/modified
# file path in a push or PR. Blank lines and lines starting with # are ignored.
#
# As of 2026-09, this repo has no paid tier — the former private repo was
# merged in. This file now guards against real secrets and personal/client
# specifics slipping in, not against a monetization split. If a paid tier
# comes back, re-add path-based patterns here first.

^\.env$
.*\.pem$
.*\.key$
^config/secrets.*
